description: A negative effect such as Poison, Bleeding or Dazed. Most Afflictions are additive. They can be prevented with a Ward, or removed by Cleansing
Triggers if this card is the first card played of the round. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect)
Ancestral effects are active while you have 4 or more cards in your Discard Pile
Increases the damage dealt by Actions by 1 per stack of Anger. (The damage bonus from Anger can, in turn, be doubled by Rampage)
When dealt damage, take 1 less damage per stack of Armor. Armor fades at the start of the turn
Ascend to a higher form, gaining more powerful buffs for each Ascended level. You can Ascend up to 3 levels
Ascended effects are active while you are currently in an Ascended form
If you are not Attuned already, attune to a random Element. Attunements empower Actions that share their type
The remaining number of cards in your deck and remaining Health are both even numbered
Whenever you gain an Affliction (except Dazzled, Jinxed or Shocked), gain an additional stack of that Affliction for each point of Bane
When dealt damage, take 1 less non-Piercing damage per stack of Barrier. Barrier does not fade, and can be Dispelled

Play your Basic Weapon attack. You start the game with several copies of your class-specific Basic Weapon, which may be relatively weak compared to later cards. If you are Disarmed, you cannot play Basic Attack cards. You can pay the Blacksmith 50 Gold to Upgrade all of your Basic Attacks, or 30 Gold to permanently Remove a Basic Attack from your deck. Some rare cards allow you to Swap all your Basic Weapon cards for another

4 possible Beastforms provide various powerful buffs (Bear, Cat, Raven, or Dragon). Only 1 Beastform can be active at a time: activating a new Beastform will replace the old one. As a Channeling card, Beastform can be extended by 1 round by having at least 1 Energy at the end of your turn, and ends when you get Interrupted
When dealt damage, take 1 additional damage per stack of Bleeding, then reduce Bleeding stacks by 1
A beneficial effect such as Regenerate, Focus or Chain. Most Blessings are additive. They can be removed by Dispelling them
Sacrifice your own blood instead of Energy in order to gain special powers. Goes hand in hand with Corruption, Darkness, Hexes, and Lifedrain
Bloodlust requires the enemy to have the Bleeding Affliction. (Reliable cards also trigger the Bloodlust effect, even when the enemy isn't Bleeding)
When dealt damage, remove Brittle. If the damage was dealt from a Melee Action, take 1 more damage per stack removed
At the end of the turn, take 1 damage per stack of Burning
Removes the top card of your deck from combat. Persistent cards cannot be Buried
Triggers when played after a card that costs 1 more or 1 less Energy. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect)
Increase the damage of the next action by 1 per stack. Chain fades if a played card did not increase Chain. Activating Chains plays a key role in raising the Tide
A Challenger has to be selected first. Opportunities return to the area deck when a Challenger is selected
A channeling effect can be extended by 1 round by having at least 1 Energy at the end of your turn. Channeled cards end when you get Interrupted
Requires an odd number of cards remaining in your deck
Cards with Charges can be played X number of times per combat before they become Depleted and are removed from combat
Lose the battle if your Health is less than your Charmed stack. When dealt non-Piercing damage, remove an equal amount of Charmed
Removes an Affliction

Codes provide a strict rule for your deck. If it is met at the Start of Combat, a code is put directly in play. If not, it gets removed. Codes are Unique and Grounded: only one Code with that name can be played per combat, and Codes can't be altered, copied or Imbued
Whenever your deck runs out of cards, you increase your Fatigue by 1, then take 10% of your Maximum Health per Fatigue in unpreventable damage
Creates a temporary card that is always Removed from your deck after use or after the combat ends, even if it has non-Removable properties such as Cursed
Triggers when played after a card of the same type (melee, magic, ranged, divine). (Reliable cards also trigger this effect)
4 or more Corruptions are present in your deck, hand and/or Discard Pile

Corruptions are cards with negative effects to their owner (Corruptions may have a negative effect when drawn, even if they are not played. Some Corruptions are unplayable (such as Envy, Greed, or Lust). If your deck contains 4 or more Corruptions, you become Corrupted, which unlocks special effects on many Blood Ritual cards.)
Critical Hits deal double damage. You can't inflict Critical Hits while Afflicted by Weakness. (Critical Hits can be buffed by the Ferocious Blessing)
Crushing requires a card to deal 10 or more damage

Cursed cards can't be Transmuted or Removed from your deck. However, they can be transformed into a card of equal rarity at a Shrine of Commerce. Conjured and One Use cards are always Removed from your deck after use or after the combat ends, even if they are Cursed
When dealt damage, take 1 less damage per stack of Darkness. When Darkness runs out, gain Stunned. Your Maximum Health is lowered by your total Darkness
When playing a card, decrease Dazed by 1. When Dazed reaches 0, gain Stunned. Dazed fades at the end of the turn
Draw one fewer card per stack of Dazzled, then decrease Dazzled stacks by 1 per skipped draw. Stacks of Dazzled cannot be increased
Inflicts Bleeding every turn. A target who has sustained 5 or more Deep Wounds is instantly slain
After playing a card, shuffle the costs of all cards in hand. Lasts 1 round per stack
Select 1 of 3 randomly selected cards
Depleted cards are removed from combat. Deplete triggers when the final Charge of a card with Charges is spent, or when Equipment has used up its Durability
While Disarmed, Basic Attack cards can't be played. Lasts 1 round per stack
Removes a card from the hand
After you play a card, it gets moved to the Discard Pile. Once your deck is empty, your Discard Pile is shuffled back into your deck
Removes a Blessing from the target
While Dominated, you can only play the randomly selected card in your hand. Exception: Reliable cards can still be played
At the end of your turn, take 1 damage for each stack of Doom. Increase Doom by 1 each time an Action is played
The number of times Equipment can be activated before it's Depleted for the remainder of the combat
Cards with Echo are cast twice when played from your hand
Empower is active while you have 5 or more Energy
When dealt Melee damage, reduce the first damage taken to 0, then decrease Evasion by 1. Evasion fades at the start of the turn
Triggers if the card with Execute is active when you defeat your foe, including if you use this card to defeat your foe
Your next Critical Hit deals 1 additional damage and heals you for 1 Health per stack of Ferocious
Conjures a copy of the card when played.
Triggers when played with 2 or fewer cards remaining in hand. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect, regardless of how many cards are left in hand)
A card with Firecast is played and moved into the discard pile whenever it gets Buried on your turn
Triggers when this card is played from either the leftmost or the rightmost position in hand. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect, regardless of their position in hand)
Triggers when played after playing at least X number of cards during the turn. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect, regardless of how many cards have been played during the turn)
At the start of the turn, draw an additional card if you have 5 or more Focus
Look at the top X cards of your deck. Put 1 on top, and the others at the bottom of your deck

Triggers when you've taken damage during your turn. (Reliable cards also trigger this effect, regardless of whether you've taken damage on your turn)
Look at the top X cards of your deck. Put one on top, and the others at the bottom of your deck

Heavy cards do not get Reshuffled after your deck reaches 0 cards
Hexes are powerful effects that debilitate foes in different ways
Holy Energy can be spent on powerful Divine cards. Goes hand in hand with Zeal

Imbuing an Enchantment Removes an Enchantment from your deck and activates it permanently, from the start of every combat. In order to be Imbued, the Enchantment card must already be present in your deck, and must last for the entire combat when activated. Grounded cards and Codes cannot be Imbued. Imbuing is expensive, often costing 100 Gold
While Impervious, take no non-Piercing damage. When dealt damage on the enemy turn, take no non-Piercing damage and decrease Impervious by 1
Add a card to this card's memory
Whenever you discard a card, take 1 damage for every point of Infected. Remove all Infected whenever you gain Health
When you Infuse a card, you convert its energy cost to Neutral (colorless). Also, if the card is Upgradeable, Infusing it will Upgrade the card as many times as its cost in energy
When you add a card with Infusion to your deck, Upgrade all other cards with Infusion by 1
Whenever you are dealt an amount of non-Piercing damage exactly the same as your current Insight, prevent that damage
Removes the target's remaining Energy (and ends their Channeling effects, including Beastform). If it targets an enemy, it will force them to replace their Deadly attacks with their regular cards
The next Action card played has no effect and reduces Jinxed by 1. (Exception: Reliable cards still have an effect.) Jinxed stacks fade at the end of the turn, and cannot be increased by Bane.
If you start the turn with more Ki than Health, remove all Ki and gain Stunned
The effects of Lasting cards are extended by 1 turn whenever the card is played again
Cards with Lifedrain restore Health equal to the damage they deal

When Mergecraft cards are added to the deck, they Upgrade all copies of that card by their Mergecraft value
Whenever you have 5 or more Momentum, remove all stacks and draw a card

Whenever a foe dies to damage, "Overkill" refers to their negative Health total. (For example, if you do 13 damage to an enemy who has 10 Health left with no defenses, they will die at –3 Health, which is the same as 3 Overkill)
Increase your current Performance by X, or start a new Performance

Piercing damage ignores all effects that would reduce or prevent its damage (such as Charmed, Impervious, Insight, and Resilient)
While Pinned, only the leftmost and rightmost cards in hand can be played. (Exception: Reliable cards can still be played, regardless of their position in your hand.) Lasts 1 round per stack

The target ends the attack at an amount of total Health ending in 0 or 5
Whenever your opponent plays a card, gain Health equal to your Rally, then lower your Rally by 1

Reaping lowers the target's Maximum Health equal to the damage it deals. When used against creatures who benefit from Anima, it lowers Anima instead. When used by creatures who benefit from Anima, Reaping damage is added to the Anima instead
Rebound counts the number of times you played the card, and triggers its special effect when the card has been played X number of times
Return the next damage dealt to you to the attacker. Increase this damage by 1 for each stack of Reflect. Fades at the start of your turn
At the start of your turn, gain 1 Health per stack and decrease Regenerate by 1

The Ambush, Bloodlust, Cascade, Continuity, Finale, Flanking, Flow, and Frenzy conditions are always met. Reliable cards ignore disabling conditions like Crushing, Jinxed, Stunned, Pinned or Dominated

Cards that are removed from your deck are permanently eliminated. You can Remove cards at Campfires, the Shrine of Potential, and some special events. (You can also pay the Blacksmith 30 Gold to Remove a Basic Attack.) Cursed cards cannot be removed from your deck. Generally, cards that are removed from your hand during combat are only Discarded, not Removed from your deck entirely. However, Conjured or One Use cards are always Removed after they are activated
Whenever your deck runs out of cards, your Discard Pile and the cards you have played (except for Conjure or One Use cards) return to your deck in a random order

At the start of the turn, reduce Shocked by 1. When Shocked reaches 0, you are Stunned. The stacks of this Affliction cannot be increased

Use the lingering essence of slain foes to empower Actions. When you die with over 100 souls collected, revive and lose all Souls
At the start of your turn, take damage equal to half of your Stagger, then reduce your Stagger by an equal amount
Stances are special fighting techniques that can be adopted through various cards. Only one Stance can be active at a time: activating a new Stance replaces the old one
Status Damage is damage taken from effects like Poison, Burning, Doomed, and Brittle. This damage typically can't be prevented except by Impervious or Cleansing the condition
While Stunned, cards cannot be played. Stunned fades at the end of the turn. (Exception: Reliable cards can still be played)
This card changes into a different card when played
Triggers whenever you play a non-Conjured card of the same type while this card is in your hand. (The card's type is found at the bottom of the card)

Tides shift the effects and power of certain Tidal cards. Generally speaking, Low Tide is the default state, but activating multiple Chains or a card that change the Tide can trigger High Tide, which unlocks more powerful effects. In a combat, only one side can enjoy the High Tide: if your opponent activates High Tide, you will go back to Low Tide.

Transmuting a card permanently converts it into a random card of the same color, with a higher rarity. For a list of what cards a card can Transmute into, see: https://blightbane.io/cards. However, Cursed cards can't be Transmuted

functions: Holy Energy } ===Functions=== *Blood Ritual: Sacrifice your own blood instead of Energy in order to gain special powers. Goes hand in hand with Corruption, Darkness, Hexes, and Lifedrain. *Buff: This effect does not itself benefit the owner, but it boosts the effect of other cards that do. *Chaos: This card randomly reshuffles the target's available cards and/or their functions. *Debuff: This effect does not itself harm the target, but it boosts the effect of other cards that do, or removes effects that benefit the target. *Deck Management: This card relates to the removal or addition of cards, and/or the order in which they are played. *Defense: This card prevents damage, or adds Maximum Health. *Energy Management: This card changes the amount or type of available Energy. *Healing: This card adds Health, or removes an Affliction. *Holy Energy: Use Holy Energy to play powerful Divine cards. Goes hand in hand with Zeal *Immunity: This card prevents a negative effect, or causes an enemy attack to deal 0 non-Piercing damage. *Instakill: This card allows for an immediate victory, without needing to reduce the opponent's Health to 0. *Offense: This card causes damage, or reduces Maximum Health. *Upgrade: This card upgrades or transmutes other cards in the deck, and may not itself be playable. *Various: This card has many possible functions. __INDEX__
